fixup_dispatch: simt_row4, then utcmma64, then utcmma128 by num_parallel_states and SM count

bf16_fixed64_final_state.partial_tail: the final block retains the fixed-64 carrier with invalid rows masked
publication_boundaries: FP32 triangular solve and H accumulation
bf16_fixed64_final_state.selector: bfloat16 qkv with requested final state, explicit alpha, and use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel false

launch_policy.checkpoint_copy_order: state fixup, optional semantic final-state recurrence, then sequence-major fixed-state boundary copy, then optional final-state scatter, then CP prefill
launch_policy.default_cp_chunk_len: checkpoint interval when enabled; otherwise pinned PR4078 choose_cp_chunk_len_host arithmetic

bfloat16: normalized_final_state_bf16 whenever output_final_state is true; use_block64_final_state is one exactly when alpha is present and use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel is false
float16: normalized_final_state when output_final_state is true and either use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel is true or alpha is absent
cp_prefill_equal_head_h32 (sm_103a only), cp_prefill_equal_head, cp_prefill, cp_prefill_generic, or the sm_100a checkpoint variants
dtype_dispatch.state_io: typed gather/scatter selected independently by state dtype and indexed-pool int32/int64 dtype; unindexed state and FP32 checkpoint copy use int32 variants

launch_policy.replay: tight-bound CUDA Graph for non-in-place state and direct captured native composite for in-place state; four ordered semantic stages and four to nine source-package kernels according to state IO form
launch_policy.stage4_checkpoint_dispatch: sm_100a float16 checkpoints use cp_prefill_checkpoint, cp_prefill_equal_head_checkpoint, or cp_prefill_generic_checkpoint; sm_103a and bfloat16 retain their terminal-disabled ordinary kernels
launch_policy.stage4_equal_head_dispatch: aligned float16 equal-head H32 inputs use cp_prefill_equal_head_h32 on sm_103a and cp_prefill_equal_head on sm_100a; other aligned float16 equal-head inputs use cp_prefill_equal_head; generic-tail, BF16, GQA, and GVA inputs retain their existing kernels
launch_policy.stage4_tail_dispatch: exact-full-block kernel iff every sequence length is divisible by 128; otherwise generic-tail kernel
launch_policy.tensor_map_abi: grid_constant for every TMA-backed stage; no process-lifetime descriptor arena

source_normalization: prepend the FlashInfer Apache-2.0 header; bracket generated C++/CUDA with clang-format markers; strip trailing blank lines and retain one final newline

checkpoint.interval: zero disables checkpoints; otherwise a positive multiple of 64 that becomes the CP chunk length

head_mapping.gqa: Hk == Hv and Hq is an integer multiple of Hk
head_mapping.gva: Hq == Hk and Hv is an integer multiple of Hq

qk_l2norm.final_state: caller-visible state is recomputed by the native FP32 token recurrence
qk_l2norm.formula: x * rsqrt(sum(x * x) + 1e-6) with FP32 arithmetic

support_contract.route: all legal pinned PR4078 SM100/SM103 CP inputs plus the declared FP32 boundary-checkpoint extension
support_contract.sequence_lengths: any nonempty tuple of nonnegative lengths, including all-empty batches, within CUDA allocation and grid limits
support_contract.state_layout: packed or unique-int32/int64 indexed pool; arbitrary positive non-overlapping [N,H,V,K] strides, optional in-place output identity
